column1: # Install-script carriers BELOW the population's download gate (ranks ~25,500-70,000),
# measured 2026-09-05 by ranking each package's versions by actual weekly downloads.
# name<TAB>weekly<TAB>latest|older-version-only. 696 of 44,055 were unresolved, so this is a floor.
# Supersedes an earlier latest-only list. That method both over- and under-counted: it missed
# the 103 carriers here that run a script only on a non-latest version, and it counted packages
# whose latest carries a script that almost nobody installs.
